name: Luka Dihujung Setia
overview: The plot follows Dhia (Zara Zya), a devoted village wife and mother. Her husband, Irsyad (Dato' Adi Putra), falls into deep financial trouble after losing his permanent job. He is forced to take up part-time work on a local plantation while bearing the weight of debts accumulated by his younger sibling.  To help alleviate their financial strain and secure a better future for their family, Dhia makes the difficult decision to leave her village and move to Kuala Lumpur alone to work. Though reluctant to part with his wife, Irsyad gives her his blessing, unaware of how heavily the long-distance separation will test their marriage.  ]
